answer_2.quote: The quality of the translations produced by each system was first evaluated using a range of automatic translation metrics, including BLEU, METEOR, BERTSCORE, COMET, and BLONDE.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on the BWB test set... we evaluated two units of linguistic context (SENTENCE and DOCUMENT) independently based on their respective FLUENCY and ADEQUACY.
answer_4.guideline: evaluated based on fluency and adequacy
